text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan II presides over Eid al-Adha prayer.
- About 251,170 new eligible voters registered in the voting lists bringing the total to 13,126,22.
- Morocco increased fourfold the telecomm sector capacity in the past 12 years. Phone customers stood at 1,251,000 in 1996 from 240,000 in 1984.
- Sugar price increased by four percent ahead of Eid al-Adha.
- Morocco and Spain seek European Union aid to finance Gibraltar tunnel.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali renews Moroccan commitment to strengthen partnership between the southern Mediterranean countries and the European Union.
- Casablanca authorities approve concession contract entitling French Lyonnaise des Eaux firm to take over power and water utilities management in the city.
- ONA, Morocco's main business group, increases net profit in 1996.
